Salman Khan Warns Cafe Owner Over Hygiene

Actor Salman Khan issued a warning to a cafe owner in Bandra, Mumbai, regarding hygiene standards. Khan reportedly told the owner that if hygiene is not maintained, he would send him to the same place as Tukaram Mundhe. Tukaram Mundhe is a former bureaucrat known for his strict enforcement of rules. The incident occurred at a cafe owned by one of Khan's friends.
